Welcome to U.S. Navy Medicine’s official YouTube sponsored by the command's Public Affairs and Outreach (N01P) division. This page is intended to provide updated information and discussion on U.S. Navy Medicine. Please visit our official homepage at med.navy.mil. 

While this is an open forum, it's also a family friendly one, so please keep your comments clean. In addition to keeping it family friendly, we ask that you follow our posting guidelines at http://www.defense.gov/socialmedia/user-agreement.aspx. Comments and posts that do not follow these guidelines will be removed.
